officialText:
The department shall adopt rules setting forth procedures for the assessment of penalties pursuant to this section, which shall include notice and an opportunity to be heard.

(L.L. 2025/048, 4/17/2025, eff. 1/12/2026)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2025/048.
